name: Stand-Up India
briefDescription: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs to set up a new (greenfield) business in manufacturing, services, trading or activities allied to agriculture.
descriptionMd: Stand-Up India, run by the Department of Financial Services (Ministry of Finance), helps **Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe and women entrepreneurs** access bank finance to start a new business. Every bank branch is expected to fund at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower for a **greenfield** (first-time) enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading, or activities allied to agriculture. For a company or firm, at least **51% of the shareholding and control** must be held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
benefitsMd:
- A **composite loan** (term loan + working capital) of **₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore**.
- A **RuPay debit card** issued for the borrower's convenience.
- **Hand-holding support** through the SIDBI Stand-Up Mitra portal — training, skilling, mentoring, project-report preparation, application help, work-shed/utility support and links to subsidy schemes.
eligibilityMd:
- The loan is for a **greenfield (brand-new) enterprise** only.
- A **male** applicant must belong to the **SC/ST** category; women of any category are eligible.
- The applicant must be **at least 18 years old**.
- The applicant must **not be in default** to any bank or financial institution.
applicationMd:
You can apply three ways — at a bank branch, through your district's Lead District Manager (LDM), or online:

**Step 1:** Go to the Stand-Up Mitra portal ([standupmitra.in](https://www.standupmitra.in/Login/Register)) and register.
**Step 2:** Enter your business location details.
**Step 3:** Select your category (SC, ST or Woman) and confirm the 51% stake condition for non-individual enterprises.
**Step 4:** Complete the application; the portal connects you to the lending bank and hand-holding agencies.

Alternatively, visit your nearest bank branch or contact your district LDM to apply offline.
